get_stop_search.title: Search for a stop
get_stop_search.description: Type the name of the stop to search for (e.g. Châtelet).

get_stop_select.title: Select the stop
get_stop_select.description: Choose the stop among the search results.

pole_confirm.title: Multimodal hub
pole_confirm.description: This stop shares a correspondence zone with other stops (ex. bus + metro platforms of the same place). Track them all as one sensor, or this stop only?

select_line.title: Line (optional)
select_line.description: Choose a line to track only that one, or "All lines" to track them all.

select_direction.title: Direction (optional)
select_direction.description: Choose a direction to track only that one, or "All directions" to track them all.

filters_manual.title: Line filter (optional)
filters_manual.description: Nothing is currently running at this stop, so the list could not be offered. Leave empty to track everything, or type a line by hand (e.g. 13). The direction can be chosen later via the options once passages are visible.

error.invalid_city: The chosen city is not valid.
error.invalid_company: The selected transit company is not valid.
error.no_stops_found: No stop found for this company.
error.no_search_results: No stop found for this search.

init.title: Line / direction filter
init.description: Change the line and direction tracked for this stop. "All lines" / "All directions" tracks everything. Quiet hours (optional): no request is sent between these two times (ex. at night). Current frequency: about {estimate} requests/day{limit_text}.

error.quota_exceeded: This frequency would mean about {estimate} requests/day{limit_text} — above the known quota. Pick a longer interval or add quiet hours.
error.quiet_hours_incomplete: Set both the start and end of the quiet-hours window, or leave both empty.
